notes.title: Major update: 0.3 | Hamlets update (Hamlet, trade & roads)
notes.content:
[h2]Hear ye, hear ye, King, Queens and Monarchs![/h2][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/dfe903511c39d5564e9e6570c4f54d6f9baaa2d7.png"][/img][/p][p]Today, we are releasing our Hamlets (and Trade) update that I arbitrarily decided to name "[b]Hit the road update[/b]" without consulting anyone (don't tell the devs!)[/p][p]In this update, we are implementing the [b]Advisor Mode,[/b] the [b]Hamlets[/b] and [b]trade[/b] system, [b]roads[/b] adapting to your evolving city, and a highly requested feature: a [b]refined destruction tool[/b] that will only delete the building and not the plot![/p][p]This update is also our biggest [b]Optimization update[/b]. [/p][p][b][u]Disclaimer[/u][/b]: Due to heavy changes in the system and build, your saves in 0.2 are not compatible with 0.3. However, we have created a 0.2 branch so you can transfer your save there. PTB Saves are not compatible either, make sure to switch to the Main branch again if you haven't already, by clicking on the "Selected Version"[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/7a96b5e45a889fb8075fa399b41e9dd1847b0a49.png"][/img][/p][h1]
Key features[/h1][h3]New “Advisor” game mode[/h3][list][*][p]This new game mode will offer stronger challenges for players who are up to the task![img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/32237e6e66dc46474b90d9f7f3482650f987974b.png"][/img][/p][/*][/list][h3]Optimization[/h3][list][*][p]We've worked hard on optimization. We knew it was one of the biggest issue tied to the game and we are happy to present our biggest optimization update. We are still working on some details along the way but you should notice many improvements while playing![/p][/*][/list][h3]Hamlets[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/82a10f498abf4fe0969eb0e20840051ea40dcbd3.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Hamlets will allow you to expand your territory and bring new resources to your territory. You can access the menu via the Town Hall. While your Burgomaster will not be available for any other activities, they will bring their skills and perks to the new hamlet![/p][/*][*][p]Gather camps now need to be placed inside the city construction area[/p][/*][/list][h3]Trade system[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/3f71f8f384ee0369a9cbaa82d9201f171e24e490.png"][/img][/h3][list][*][p]Hilde's Trade Post will be unlocked with the Hamlets and will allow you to obtain gold in a different way than expanding, so you can have control over your growth.[/p][/*][*][p]This was requested by the community several times. It was originally suggested to be tied with the market itself but we wanted a system that would make more sense: if we were to use the marketplace, it would have been implied getting the money from your population. [/p][/*][*][p]This feature will allow you to have a different form of income without implementing taxes that we feel are a bit too idle.[/p][/*][*][p]We hope it will make your progression interesting! Please let us know your thoughts![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Resource depletion, agriculture and balancing[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/d0dd0db1b046a78fcf4e872f1b10149bcab489ff.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]With the introduction of the Hamlets and Trade system, we have changed the resource depletion and regeneration. They will deplete a bit faster and you will have to be a bit more careful with the management of your production chain. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]We have also deleted the agriculture zones, so you can now place your orchards, vineyards and farms anywhere you want![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h2]Mechanics and core changes[/h2][list][*][p][b]New deletion tool and the ability to cancel construction[/b][/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/mdEFzUa.gif"][/img][/p][list][*][p]The building deleting feature was highly requested by our community and it took us a bit more time than expected to implement it with a satisfying result. [/p][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/FiyDdIw.gif"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]We also implemented a "Cancel" construction feature, that will allow you to cancel it if you missclick or change your mind.[/p][/*][*][p]It has a few ripple effects on the spatial puzzle that we were and are still worried about so please let us know what your think![/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Changes in narration[/b][/p][list][*][p]When starting a new game, you can now choose to play without narration and without tutorial. [/p][/*][*][p][b]For your first game, the tutorial and narration will be enabled by default. However, as soon as you've progressed a bit in the game, all your subsequent new games will allow you to disable these options as you wish[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/e8bb7c7ff227b413abe819f940702161c8058d23.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]This will allow you to create more freely without reading through the story. This change made us rethink the narration was intertwined with core features. [/p][/*][*][p]We have separated Narrative quests with the “Main Quest” that will unlock new buildings and new elements, you can prioritize easily and differentiate them in the UI, the Advisor will guide you well.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/6193ae7d689530cf1e07f2f3ad30dfb1154c8f29.png"][/img]In “Non Narrative mode”, you will only get the Main quests. [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Life, visuals[/h2][list][*][p][b]Citizens and transporter[/b]: your city is coming to life with transporters carts instead of backpacks[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fancier roads[/b]: As your city evolve, the roads will evolve with it from dirt to stone to paved roads[/p][/*][*][p][b]Habitation fusion[/b]: Higher-tier habitation sometimes fuses with their neighbor after upgrading[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="https://i.imgur.com/TtexAur.gif"][/img][/p][hr][/hr][h2]Supporter Pack[/h2][list][*][p]4 more tracks have been added to the Supporter pack![/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/379dca50493a5f4865a60f1e9d65d2a329445884.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h2][b]0.2 Disclaimer[/b][/h2][p][b][u]Disclaimer[/u][/b]: Due to heavy changes in the system and build, your saves in 0.2 are not compatible with 0.3. However, we have created a 0.2 branch so you can transfer your save there. [/p][list][*][p]Right-click on “City Tales - Medieval Era” > Betas > in “Beta Participation” select “Version_0_2_0”[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/9681243a4fe2e6177a68156b08a917691162c4b4.png"][/img][/p][p]You can find your savegame in [i]{disk}:\\Users\\{username}\\AppData\\LocalLow\\Irregular Shapes\\City Tales\\saves\\{steam_userid}\\[/i][/p][list][*][p]Each folder with a number is a save slot with 0 being your autosave[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][h1][/h1][h1]Full patchnotes[/h1][h2]Highlight[/h2][list][*][p]Reworks building perks to be the same for all building types[/p][/*][*][p]Companion quest can be given up[/p][/*][*][p]Limiting quests to 2 active companion quests[/p][/*][*][p]Deprecates save prior to 0.3.0.1 + adds deprecated save UI[/p][/*][*][p]Three new quest related to a new Companion[/p][/*][*][p]4 new music tracks[/p][/*][*][p]Hamlets[/p][list][*][p]You can expand your city by creating hamlets and naming one of your trusted companion as burgomaster[/p][/*][*][p]Gather camps now need to be placed inside the city construction area[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New destruction mode[/p][list][*][p]You can destroy a building without destroying its parcel[/p][/*][*][p]In progress constructions can be canceled[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Performances[/p][list][*][p]Many changes have been made to improve the performance of the game, particularly with larger cities[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Carts[/p][list][*][p]NPCs carriers now use carts instead of backpack[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New economy buildings[/p][list][*][p]Eight new production buildings with their unique visuals[/p][/*][*][p]New resources[/p][/*][*][p]New civil building upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Houses can be upgraded one more time[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]New “Advisor” game mode for more challenge[/p][/*][*][p]Narration[/p][list][*][p]The city progression and building unlocks are now separate from the main story[/p][/*][*][p]New option to play without the main story[/p][/*][*][p]Each companion has a new quest to further your relationship with them[/p][/*][*][p]Many existing quests and objectives have been reworked[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][h2]Other[/h2][list][*][p]Building and upgrading civil building have different costs (upgrading a chapel to a church has a different cost than building a church directly)[/p][/*][*][p]Habitations now start with their maximum of inhabitants, instead of gradually growing over a few minutes[/p][h3]Performances (detailed)[/h3][list][*][p]Improves performances of carriers NPCs[/p][/*][*][p]Improves rendering performances of all buildings[/p][/*][*][p]Improves rendering performances of fields[/p][/*][*][p]Improves rendering performances of castle[/p][/*][*][p]Improves performances during district creation and building placement[/p][/*][*][p]Improves rendering performances of the terrain[/p][/*][*][p]Improves rendering performances of building alert icons[/p][/*][*][p]Improves performances of road creation[/p][/*][*][p]Improves rendering performances of collectable stones[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Grass has been mowed below collectable resources[/p][/*][*][p]Vegetation fields growing animation has been replaced by a new, more organic one[/p][h3]Balancing[/h3][list][*][p]Overall rebalancing of the economy to prepare for the new buildings and resources[/p][/*][*][p]Town hall construction area are smaller (but can be extended using hamlets)[/p][/*][*][p]Town hall upgrades and castle construction cost less gold[/p][/*][*][p]Reworked position of resources on maps[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Removes fertility zone for animal and vegetation fields[/p][/*][*][p]Add game mode to save tooltip[/p][/*][*][p]Updates vinque font for better readability of some letters[/p][/*][*][p]Player name and city name can be longer (from 12 to 16 characters)[/p][/*][*][p]Increases camera panning speed at high altitude[/p][/*][*][p]Adds UI to castle placement[/p][/*][*][p]Influence areas: minimizes overlaps between symbols[/p][h3]UI[/h3][list][*][p]Updates end of EA screen text and buttons[/p][/*][*][p]Reworks perks UI (production wheel, tooltips, icons) 🔵🟣[/p][/*][*][p]Updates destruction buttons UI[/p][/*][*][p]Updates dialogue UI[/p][/*][*][p]Adds hover/pressed state to notification card[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Put all non-English words in italic in dialogues[/p][/*][*][p]Removes delay before mouse camera drag and rotation[/p][/*][*][p]Adds specific dialogue per companion to autonomy tutorial[/p][/*][*][p]Updates translation team credits (new members, fixed job title)[/p][/*][*][p]Adds perks onboarding[/p][/*][*][p]More mill visual variety[/p][h3]Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixes building a civil building on two houses additional money cost is not actually paid if the district has only one house[/p][/*][*][p]Removes crane from loading screen[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes fences are badly updated after building or parcel deletion[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes visual borders of large collectable resource zones[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes experience gained by buildings was not uniform[/p][/*][*][p]Fixes destruction highlight icon priority notes.title: Our new Roadmap and a teaser on the upcoming update!
notes.content:
[h3]Hear, hear, dear Monarchs![/h3][p][/p][p]Hope you are excited for TactiCon as we will be part of the event with [b]our new update and a sale[/b]! Join us on July 17th to celebrate the best of strategy games with talks, demos and sales![/p][p][/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcKpiZMZ4lsfqTDXGzs0C9zN3kWLEnw4nkRA2rUpP1OCTmvQdlAMjCi2VmyuHGeQySx5RfzSks8-KYI7cs5xxMCoNoE6n414QokAn6LG1DlJDFnHFJ72gcgbIshVEHw5HwRUTrpSA?key=IxSbPn64jOcCmQJIvYafgg"][/img][/p][h3][b]Our updated Roadmap:
[/b][/h3][p]As the title suggests, we’ve revamped our Roadmap: we wanted to dedicate more time to improving key elements, such as the UI and the overall visuals of the game. Therefore, we had to move some content to later updates to focus on the visuals first and foremost.[/p][p][/p][p]You can take a look at the upcoming additions that will be there very soon![/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXfDPbiifTOniWITqQ8LAG4jVCAS4bRGloqxPF5cycSR8qHJ-kV7fKIxeoLdiFZpCCqiEvSP-rTdVtcHf0_Jn7QWQUgVjPqF8khgPTVA3O3m5KUAHhU-OhexXWIvvZnSnOyLWzuhBA?key=IxSbPn64jOcCmQJIvYafgg"][/img][/p][p]Our priority was to update the visuals and interface of the game before diving into the gameplay itself, and as you can see, there’s still plenty of new content, gameplay-wise, planned for the rest of the year. [/p][p]The next update will be released on [b]July 16th [/b]and here is a small teaser on what you can expect in it! 👀
[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXdKNlOYJ_9wns7HpKuBc6j38ri3CINRsrfYO7ZeZ_aAAgtvaZpwnI_Hfgs4-W8C0Xzn9auKVxKHnqeZCGSTGrt6ZURzZE31X2JgSWwDOs5mLHYcKxsLMLMtMgTo5fzArA8rkGiDxA?key=IxSbPn64jOcCmQJIvYafgg"][/img][/p][p]We’ve also read all your reviews on Steam! Thank you for your kindness, support, and for bringing light on some features that needed to be improved. Among this feedback, the performance was one of the main topics you highlighted, and we can already tell you that we’re currently working on improving the performance issues, and it will be featured in the next update [b]in September.[/b] [/p][p][/p][p]As we already stated in previous messages, this Early Access is here to build this game alongside you, our players, so don’t hesitate to join our Discord servers to let us know your suggestions for the future of the game, to share your screenshots, and to discuss with the whole dev team! We also give insights and exclusive information to our Discord members in priority so if you want to know everything before everyone, you know where to find us![/p][p]
>> [url="https://link.irregular-shapes.com/Discord" style="button" buttoncolor="#705dd0"]JOIN DISCORD[/url] <<[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned for the upcoming update and take care of yourself, lieges![/p][p][/p][p]-The Irregular Shapes Team -[/p]

notes.title: Our FAQ for Early Access on May 22nd 🏰
notes.content:
Hear hear Monarchs!

Be ready: City Tales - Medieval Era will be coming to Early Access on[b] May 22nd[/b]! To prepare this launch in the best conditions, we've tried to answer the most anticipated questions on the game and its Early Access in the following FAQ! If other questions are crossing your mind, feel free to ask them!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/babf3552341424581a11febb1aff33a720e50799.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/a04a63198a8f6c9f707e644d29ece9a35252acb8.png[/img]

[i]City Tales: Medieval Era[/i] is a project made by a small French team, and we are passionate about building a community and [b]including their feedback over the course of development[/b]. We already have many new ideas to include, and we want to ensure they are implemented in a way that is meaningful to our players. We believe that early access provides the best environment for this to happen. Building step by step the game with our ideas alongside your opinions and feedback on the game's journey towards full release is something that we are super excited to experience.

It's very important for us to identify missing functionality, issues, and sentiment toward a feature via Early Access players' feedback, as we are still in development. This way, we can create a game that will tell our collective story.
We aim to listen closely to our growing community while working and delivering what we have planned so we can iterate and improve, shaping the game together so our vision aligns with our community.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/3f229d2d1260ea505b08a965f70bc20a32c313c0.png[/img]

We are aiming for [b]a year in Early Access[/b], but we might take slightly more or less time depending on your feedback during the Early Access. It's important to us to provide a full and polished product that both delivers on our promised vision and the enjoyment of early access players. It would not be beneficial neither for us and nor for you, the players, to rush a product or give a release date too early that we could not reach in the end, that is why when we are sure about our fully release date, we will communicate it with you as soon as possible.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/e93a1f8f2ffab524099c445a6b471be4786d79d6.png[/img]

In the current Early Access of the game, you have access to:
[list]
[*] 2 game modes: [i]Settler[/i] for the players looking for a solid balance between the story and economy system & [i]Bard[/i] for the players who want to experience the story with more control and less economic and spatial challenge
[*] First companions storylines
[*] First main quest
[*] A solid economy and an organic building system already allow you to create a beautiful medieval city filled with life, with 50 types of buildings and 40 resources at your disposal
[*] The options to add decorations to your roads and city
[*] 2 maps with 3 starting points
[*] Upgrade up to level 5 for houses
[*] Localization in 7 languages (see Language section of this FAQ)
[/list]
The game will be updated with new additions and changes, thanks to your feedback and our ideas for this project, during the whole Early Access. We are working on a Roadmap that will be shared in the coming days and give you insight into what is planned for these different updates!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/11b8aa5c06d3c8f73ed7ba5bbd5d455947cf13f1.png[/img]

The companions are special characters that are different from the rest of the inhabitants of your city. They are the workforce you can count on for your production buildings, but they are also faithful individuals with [b]their own issues, stories, and emotions[/b]. As their monarch, you can choose to learn more about who they are and even be part of their tales.

For the Early Access release, [b]9 companions[/b] will be available.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/dd7483448b1e0246e2f1875d26c31755931ed7b9.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/1addb0d857e95cddfb01bca8d2a51ca3d25ac00c.png[/img]

City Tales is a relaxed and cozy game, so you won’t have to go to up in arms with other countries and nations. However, we are planning to implement some forms of threats for those looking for challenges.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/98d88d0f5f992b7a55f33afd8f132ef2efe9a576.png[/img]

Our maps are handmade and tied to the lore and story, so they are not procedurally generated. 
For Early Access, you will have access to [b]2 maps and 3 starting points[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/06bc54442cbd3a2ddf874d990df143754db47972.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/78376b9e728138637dac1fe84960d21467395591.png[/img]

At the Early Access release, [b]7 languages[/b] will be available, and others might be added later during the development process.

For the Early Access release, the languages available will be:
[list]
[*] English
[*] French
[*] German
[*] Spanish
[*] Russian
[*] Ukrainian
[*] Simplified Chinese
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/cbae046cfd1a331aa31fa318c6378399a178ff74.png[/img]

The main objective of this Early Access is to build by your side the best game’s experience possible of [i]City Tales - Medieval Era[/i]. All feedback is valuable to us, whether it concerns a feature that you hate or on the contrary love, a mechanic or option that is lacking and you would like to see implemented, a suggestion for the visuals or the gameplay…

Sharing your thoughts on the game will help us focus and prioritize the new additions to implement in the game. You can share your feedback through many different processes:
[list]
[*] Share your screenshots
[*] Fill in our survey
[*] Join [url=https://discord.gg/C4qMcjdc]our Discord[/url] to discuss with us
[*] Share feedback on Steam Discussions or Discord forum channels
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/4b467800bd8f964ac39830ee45572cf5c7defd61.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/79bf73d72dea8a12dbef9b44ce93131923f6383a.png[/img]

We have many plans for the full release, but also new additions during the Early Access period, thanks to your feedback and our ideas discussed during this journey!
We have an Early Access Roadmap that will be shared in the future for you to have a clear vision in the long-term of what we plan for the future of City Tales - Medieval Era. 

Some of our projects and ideas are:
[list]
[*] Localization in more languages
[*] New game modes
[*] UI updates
[*] "Wonders and Masterworks" system, a high stake, high rewards type of building that will require good management and planning.
[*] More maps
[*] 14 fully fledged companions with their storyline
[*] New resources, new buildings, and new production lines
[*] More impacting choices through narration
[*] Expanded Companion System
[*] More mid and late-game mechanics: Mysteries & Discoveries, Hamlets & Territory expansion, Escorts & Caravans, Castle expansion
[*] And more!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/efba5b51b4bfb4a97638089193276b0d09eb8bb0.png[/img]

The price between the Early Access and the v.1 release will be different. We plan to only slightly increase the price between Early Access and full release, according to the increase in content and features.

In Early Access, the game will cost[b] 19.99 Euros, 19.99 USC, 16.75 GPB, and 68 CNY[/b].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/4f0a6c84a6e75b8a2dc952391b56c31c111254f0.png[/img]

City Tales is a colorful medieval city builder with an artistic direction that leans towards a [b]calm and relaxing ambiance[/b]. With its bright colors and cozy atmosphere, our city builder offers the possibility of creating your dream city, both luxurious and complex.

The neighborhoods in City Tales are organic, and you can decide their shapes thanks to our district tool in-game. From a square to a circle and even a heart, your city’s districts can take any shape you desire. Roads will adapt to your city’s layout to bring the vision of your city to life.

The companions are also both part of the narrative and the gameplay mechanics. These special people will share their stories with you and be pillars of your city’s growth and prosperity. You can assign these companions to production buildings where they can train apprentices who will automate the production of the resources linked to this building.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/844800e63eca1a05e445c7715e5aa6e3ca6ee752.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/08683701dfe6f3cd886c71c7e3700b43666faa25.png[/img]

No, City Tales - Medieval Era will have no multiplayer options. It is a [b]solo experience[/b].


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/9fe5c0bd9da70a797abb251140051286eef51e5a.png[/img]

There will be no Modding system in City Tales - Medieval Era. Supporting an internal modding support via Steam Workshop would be a lot of work so it’s not in our plans for Early Access, as we prefer working on core mechanics, ideas and improving the base game during this time. We might reconsider it later.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/4f8ddc4fc03ef257ea4defb5a65d314dfbfa4ef4.png[/img]


If you have other questions, feel free to ask them either on Steam or on Discord, we would be more than happy to answer them! Thank you for taking the time to read us and for your incredible support!

The Irregular Shapes Team

notes.title: Architects Log II: Demo, Feedbacks, onwards!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/f4d48c27aca927aef1e04b1e9fae4cf6039d0ae9.png[/img]

Long time no see, monarchs and builders!

Many things happened since our announcement trailer for City Tales - Medieval Era! 

One Demo, 50k wishlist and a release date, among other things!

Our little community is growing and we couldn’t be happier to see you play the demo and share your screenshots with us!

While you were playing an early build of our game, we have also been pretty busy on our side, gathering your feedback, working hard on implementing new features and refining core mechanics!

We will share our roadmap soon but here is a small sneak peek of what we are working on!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/89488b587b35fd556d60662683ee315cfa3804f1.png[/img]

[h2] 🖼️ Graphics[/h2]

First and foremost, we have heard your biggest feedback: The grass is now greener than ever!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/2e71f1907cc6ae6eeeb4ce189061ff19695894ba.png[/img]
All jokes aside, we have reworked both lighting and shaders so we are moving toward warmer and more natural colours, while still keeping a vibrant colour palette (this is still a work in progress though!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/aa99a849ad3b6712bd778490d0879407d9fcf9b5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/89488b587b35fd556d60662683ee315cfa3804f1.png[/img]

[h2] 📈 Performances [/h2]

We are still working on performances and optimization on the Early Access Build. We want the game to be accessible as much as possible, the process is taking some time so we can’t share much but we can already say that we have made some improvements.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/89488b587b35fd556d60662683ee315cfa3804f1.png[/img]

 [h2]🏡 District Creation [/h2]

We have now added a button and a keybind for the District creation tool (also tied to middle mouse button and Shift).

District exclusion area will also show up when you get close to it so it will be easier for you to shape your city!

You will also be able to see the influence area of your district while building it!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/fUPL8hx.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/89488b587b35fd556d60662683ee315cfa3804f1.png[/img]

[h2] 📜 Intro [/h2]

We are working on a new introduction feature where you will be able to choose your name, title and the map you want to start on, among other things! You will even be able to meet your very first companions and rename them!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/2da11fc062bbf24fe61c35b008b975ecec4be0df.png[/img]
We will also add more game modes, though they will not arrive at the same time during Early Access, and a few distinct starting points for a change of scenery, spatial and resources challenges depending on your choices.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/ae37992a807896554ee54b1c8d48865697e5462c.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/89488b587b35fd556d60662683ee315cfa3804f1.png[/img]

[h2] 🧭 Influence area [/h2]

This is also still a work in progress.

One of our core mechanics is the management of Influence Area from Civil Buildings, where influence will be given by the district harboring the civil building (and not by the building itself). Previously, it was drawn as a full circle radiating from the center of your district, influencing a neighboring district if 40% of it was in range. 

We are reworking the UX and UI to make it clearer and easier to read. While the 40% rule is still in effect, the shape of the influence area will now adapt according to the system to make it less confusing. You will even be able to see the shape change while creating your district if you have filters on and see the influence area of the district your building in real time.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/c963ece771ec59d9bc0b3906e99a9574ad7a3237.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/89488b587b35fd556d60662683ee315cfa3804f1.png[/img]

[h2] 🌲 Decorations [/h2]

We are slowly adding decorations and ornaments! You will unlock more and more decorations as you progress and we will add more during early access.

This is still a work in progress, some decorations shown here might differ or not be all available at release due to polishing and balancing.
[img]https://i.imgur.com/GhmcW0G.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/89488b587b35fd556d60662683ee315cfa3804f1.png[/img]

[h2]🦆 Life in the city & animals [/h2]

Last but not least, we have changed the resource and hunting system so farewell giant boars and deers in the streets and castle!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/JGSMYgX.gif[/img]
Additionally, we have added more life and animations to the city, reworked our character models and we are filling the world with more details. But this will be the topic of our next Architect Log!
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RwXZsEE.gif[/img]

Thank you for your reading and thank you for your support!

The Irregular Shapes Team

notes.title: Architects Log I: The End (Not Clickbait)
notes.content:
Greetings future Monarchs and happy new year!

Welcome to our very first Architects Log (which is a fancy word for Dev Log that I just came up with)

With the end of 2024, we look forward to our next adventure but before that, we also want to thank you and take a look back to our incredible journey so far!

And what-a-ride!

This year, we ended with a bang at [b]PC Gaming Show[/b] with our trailer finally out in the world and we can proudly say that [b]“we built something beautiful”[/b] and we will continue to build something to be proud of!

2025 will also start with a demo coming soon and more announcements to come!

[h3]📜 "Once upon a time"
[/h3]
Our adventure started in June 2022 with the creation of Irregular Shapes and part of the team joined Rémi on October 2023, growing from 4 people to 11 talented members.

We had one dream and a woodcutter’s axe… and ideas for organic districts creation while your inhabitants would create roads.

So it was natural for us to create a type of game we were passionate about: A City-Builder.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/6ffb90eae88dbb80ecbcc9e3c5d958bb57679f51.gif[/img]

Back in the days, the project was called [b]“Land of Medieval Cities” [/b](very original, much wow) and houses looked like Golden Grahams in a green field.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/74d9febfc98489f7f2102b83bcfdd25b363b58f6.png[/img]

With some interesting results… (no cows were harmed in the process!)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/fd9b44f885bd26b85b228c8b51ca48e70e60335a.png[/img]

[h2]👀 Some hints and what to expect[/h2]

Influence area and resources will be at the core of our city-builder and we are working hard to improve and shape the economy system. We wanted to have a meaningful system, tied to our district mechanics that could evolve with your actions.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/0f82727e58aa76cdde606a446b76e5fe583aef95.png[/img]

It might seems overwhelming but you will not be alone ! Several companions will join you in your journey. The narrative twist is here to embody the evolution of your city. As you progress, your story will too and your decision will affect those who gravitate around you one way or another!

The Advisor is the first figure you will meet (but we have many more to come!) He has changed quite a bit over the past few years (and you might recognize him from somewhere…)
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45332361/573133edb5a500c7d21b438ac59eda82eeb5950b.png[/img]

[h2]📣 Reveal[/h2]

The highlight of the year? On December 5th, we officially revealed *City Tales - Medieval Era* during the PC Gaming Show!

[previewyoutube=G2yu3zmtmQs;full]Trailer si Steam veut bien[/previewyoutube]


[h2]🌟 To 2025[/h2]


We are currently putting the finishing touches on [b]a playable demo of City Tales - Medieval Era[/b], which will be available very soon.

 From the bottom of our heart, we want to thank you for being part of this journey—we can’t wait to share what’s next with you!

2025 will be the year we bring our little gem to you, players, and we will continue together!

Cheers!

[i]- Irregular Shapes Team[/i]
